def transform(g):
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==2]
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    # main row: row with >=2 points
    from collections import Counter
    rc=Counter(i for i,j in pts)
    mainrow=max(rc,key=lambda k:rc[k])
    rowp=sorted(j for i,j in pts if i==mainrow)
    for j in range(rowp[0]+1,rowp[-1]):
        out[mainrow][j]=3
    for i,j in pts:
        if i==mainrow: continue
        step=1 if i<mainrow else -1
        k=i+step
        while k!=mainrow:
            out[k][j]=3
            k+=step
    return out
assert transform(gi)==go
